channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Donte DiVincenzo | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Donte DiVincenzo from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Tim Connelly on Donte DiVincenzo
item.description:
Tim Connelly:

“Donte (DiVincenzo) looks great. As you guys all know, Donte attacks everything like he attacks the court. I thought our medical staff and his agents did a great job of quickly getting it addressed. He was under the knife 24 hours after the surgery. He looks as good as we'd hoped. We don't want to put any added pressure on him, butwe're cautious and optimistic that we're going to see Donte this season and we know how much he brings to our team.”

Tim Connelly on Donte DiVincenzo, Sep 30, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Josh Hart on Donte DiVincenzo
item.description:
Josh Hart on Donte DiVincenzo’s return to MSG this Sunday with the Wolves:

“I think he should be received with cheers and ovation for everything he did for the team last year. He put his body on the line and brought it every night. I think he should get a warm welcome.”

Josh Hart on Donte DiVincenzo, Oct 11, 2024. Source: x.com.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Julius Randle, Karl-Anthony Towns, Donte DiVincenzo
item.description:
Tom Thibodeau:

“Julius Randle and Donte DiVincenzo added a lot to our team. We had a need at the center position…. To get a player of (Karl-Anthony Towns') stature was huge. You don’t get a player like that without giving good players up.”

Tom Thibodeau on Julius Randle, Karl-Anthony Towns, Donte DiVincenzo, Oct 3, 2024. Source: x.com.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Donte DiVincenzo
item.description:
Dustin Dopirak:Rick Carlisle:

“Donte DiVincenzo is a great player. And in the first three games, we didn't treat him like he was. We didn't treat him with that level of urgency.”

Rick Carlisle on Donte DiVincenzo, May 12, 2024. Source: Twitter @DustinDopirak.

item.title: Josh Hart on Monty Williams, Donte DiVincenzo
item.description:
Josh Hart on Monty Williams’ Donte DiVincenzo comments:

“If he didn’t want to be part of the story, he should’ve told his guys to defend better. What else there to say? We’ve got a guy that’s hot. We’re going to try to find the guy that’s hot. That’s common sense in basketball.”

Josh Hart on Monty Williams, Donte DiVincenzo, Mar 26, 2024. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Kelly Oubre on Isaiah Hartenstein, Donte DiVincenzo
item.description:
Kelly Oubre on the scuffle with Isaiah Hartenstein/Donte DiVincenzo:

“I don’t got no enemies in this league. It was just funny. All of that stuff is funny to me. I don’t know why. I just laugh ‘cause nobody’s gonna fight. So at the end of the day, I’ll see you Tuesday, bruv.”

Kelly Oubre on Isaiah Hartenstein, Donte DiVincenzo, Mar 11, 2024. Source: Twitter @Krisplashed.

item.title: Josh Hart on Donte DiVincenzo
item.description:
Knicks guard Josh Hart on Donte DiVincenzo after Team USA practice today at UNLV:

“They’re gonna love him, man. He’s a New York-style player. That blue-collar, hard worker. That’s what he does.”

Josh Hart on Donte DiVincenzo, Aug 3, 2023. Source: Twitter @IanBegley.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Donte DiVincenzo
item.description:
Curry said at the American Century Championship.

“I know he [Donte DiVincenzo] was coming off of an injury and trying to find a situation that could help him establish who he is as NBA player and how much value he brings to winning teams. “And he proved that above and beyond with us all year. He knows how to play the game. You can tell he won at the highest level in college. The Knicks got a good one and I’m happy that he got his fair share of that CBA, too. So it was good.”

Stephen Curry on Donte DiVincenzo, Jul 13, 2023. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: Brook Lopez on Donte DiVincenzo
item.description:
Kane Pitman:Brook Lopez on DiVincenzo knocking down the tying free-throw to save the season:

“I had faith he would make it. That was obviously so mentally tough. He's been in situations like that before obviously in college. He's risen to the occasion before and we were all 100% behind him.”

Brook Lopez on Donte DiVincenzo, Sep 6, 2020. Source: Twitter @KanePitman.
